experiment: Keyed randomized hashing for the latest-series map in the fused Mimir instant scan
retention_decision: First exact-image control is mixed. Median candidate/baseline CPU, RSS, query p99 and ingest p99 ratios are 1.0065, 1.0074, 0.9519 and 1.1481. Querier median CPU ratio is 0.9150, but the third pair has higher querier CPU and query p99. No repeatable whole-stack advantage is qualified. Repeat the exact images and preserve every observation before retention.

scope.change: Only the ephemeral latest-series HashMap uses ahash::RandomState. Keep the cold conflict HashMap, canonical series fingerprints, complete equality checks, final fingerprint sort, cold-first labels, hot-first ties, sample counting, stale markers, one snapshot and all fallback paths unchanged.
scope.dependency: Expose existing ahash 0.8.12 directly to krabka-promql. Cargo.lock adds one dependency edge; no package versions change. Default runtime randomness remains enabled.

negative_control.mutation: Reverse the final canonical fingerprint sort with the candidate hasher.
negative_control.result: Exactly the independent full production scan ledger fails; 65 other metrics-service unit cases pass. Original candidate restored.

comparison_plan: Independently checksummed release images built from the rebased baseline and candidate on private GCP runners. Verify seven binaries, image config, base layer and all nonbinary paths. Three fresh alternating baseline/candidate pairs plus three native Mimir pairs; steady 60-second load with unchanged aggregate budgets. Include broker and MinIO CPU/RSS; require accepted rows, query results, telemetry coverage and no errors/OOM.

pairs.pairing: Three fresh baseline/candidate deployment pairs on one VM, alternating first revision; native comparison also retained separately.
pairs.scope: Single-node API-accepted steady load with identical query pacing and accepted row counts; actual query completions are recorded and may vary with latency. Matched aggregate budgets; CPU and RSS include broker and MinIO.

native_comparison.scope: Fixed deployment-shape, single-node API-accepted performance; different durability contracts
native_comparison.aggregation: median/min/max and raw values of three repetitions, no confidence intervals
